faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Juvenile Justice Board Cuddalore recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Juvenile Justice Board Cuddalore recruitment is 25th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What are the different posts available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment offers three distinct posts: Assistant cum Bench Clerk, Junior Assistant cum Record Clerk, and Office Assistant. Each post has specific educational qualifications and salary structures.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for these positions?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement for all posts is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is 42 years. Age relaxation may be applicable as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Assistant cum Bench Clerk post?
faq.answer: For the Assistant cum Bench Clerk position, candidates must hold any Bachelor Degree from a recognized university. A preference will be given to those with Computer on Office Automation qualification.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these positions primarily involves Document Verification. Candidates are advised to ensure all their documents are in order.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary structure for the Office Assistant post?
faq.answer: The Office Assistant post offers a monthly salary of Rs. 13,000/-. This is part of the contract-based employment offered by the Juvenile Justice Board Cuddalore.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is strictly Offline. Candidates need to download the application form and send it to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the total number of vacancies announced?
faq.answer: A total of 3 vacancies have been announced for the Assistant cum Bench Clerk, Junior Assistant cum Record Clerk, and Office Assistant posts combined.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Juvenile Justice Board Cuddalore, which is www.cuddalore.nic.in. Links are also provided in the 'Important Links' section of this article.
